# Stellar Business Development Agency

Stellar Business Development Agency is operated by Apropos Group LLC, an independent private business and not a government agency.

Canonical homepage: https://sbda.stellaruc.com/

## Mission
Providing businesses with contract access, visibility, and intelligent business systems.

Technology partner: STELLAR INTELLIGENT SOFTWARE DEVELOPERS — CUSTOM BUSINESS SYSTEMS.

PRODUCTIVITY · EXTENDED COVERAGE · PROFITABILITY

## Complimentary Contract Opportunity Discovery
https://bdms.aproposgroupllc.com
The BDMS search service is a separate operational system. Stellar Business Development Agency does not guarantee contract eligibility or awards.

## Nevada Business License Service
https://sbda.stellaruc.com/nevada-business-license
Articles of Organization, Initial List and State Business License prepared and filed with the Nevada Secretary of State. Cost is reviewed in a consultation before anything is filed.

## Free Business Profile Ad
https://sbda.stellaruc.com/free-vendor-card
Businesses can request a free Vendor Card in the Stellar Business Development Agency Business Registry. Email confirmation is required before publication.
